confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of unauthorized access from an unusual IP, followed by the downloading of sensitive files and the immediate exfiltration of those files to a personal email address.

attack_chain.description: Successful login from an unusual IP (103.45.67.89) instead of the baseline IP (192.168.1.100).
Accessing sensitive confidential directories within the finance department.
Exfiltrating the first downloaded file to a personal Gmail account via email.
Exfiltrating the second downloaded file to the same personal Gmail account.

gaps: Verification of whether user_01 was traveling or using a VPN, which might explain the unusual IP.
Confirmation of whether the email attachments actually contained the downloaded files (though sizes match perfectly).
narrative: User_01 logged in from an unrecognized IP address and accessed highly sensitive financial files. Following the downloads, the user sent two emails to a personal Gmail account with attachment sizes that exactly match the downloaded files, indicating a successful data exfiltration incident.
